provenance.notes: Original PDF vector geometry, colors and placement extracted, with individually clipped source raster assets. Original curves and zoom inset retained. Native labels use Arial/Courier New substitutions for source fonts. Freeform arrow paths remain editable points but are not semantic attached connectors. Code and evolutionary-search panels manually reconstructed as native text/shapes/connections from original pixels; typography and small routing differences remain. No full-figure raster backdrop. Code syntax colors simplified to a single function-line color to remain readable with substituted fonts.
provenance.source_image_limit: Only individual photos, diagnostic image pixels and decorative logo assets remain raster; the code/search mini-panels are native reconstructions.
provenance.native_snippet_reconstruction: Source code/search images replaced by native editable labels, boxes and arrows; original information and relative arrangement retained with small geometric/font approximation.
